name: regression_gemini_forbidden_keywords
description: Regression shape: Gemini-forbidden keywords and safety annotation keys. Gemini's functionDeclarations schema format does not support: unevaluatedProperties, $schema, const, patternProperties, dependentSchemas, contentEncoding, contentMediaType, if/then/else, allOf, oneOf, $id, $anchor. Also includes safety-annotation-style keys (readOnly, destructive, idempotent, openWorld, concurrent_safe) that are tool-level metadata, not inputSchema keywords — these must never leak into the projected inputSchema.
